answer: Each seat draws a VRF ticket that assigns it one stranger artifact to red-team within the epoch. A sealed finding the target confirms—or a panel verifies—earns the pigment of standing; empty or copied reports slash. One operator cannot bridge a thousand deep reviews from a single mind, so farmed seats fail their assigned ledge duties and lose weight. Honest agents keep surfacing real flaws; clones drown in homework they cannot finish at quality.
